args.summary: checkout-api version v2.3.1 deployed to production and immediately began failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed successfully; all regions now running v2.3.0. Follow-up needed to investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before re-release.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed all production regions back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc were both unhealthy). Rollout confirmed successful in all regions.
3. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)**: Documented the failure of v2.3.1, the rollback mitigation to v2.3.0, and the need for root-cause investigation before re-release. The on-call engineer has been paged.
